info.about: Wario Land II, known in Japan as Wario Land 2: The Stolen Treasure, is a 1998 platform game developed and published by Nintendo for the Game Boy.
info.trivia: The original Game Boy release reached North America in March 1998, eleven months before the colorized Game Boy Color version followed it in February 1999.
info.why: Nintendo replaced it on shelves with the Game Boy Color version within a year, so the original Game Boy cartridge had the shorter retail life of the two.
